feel_about_people: People are tools. Use them for your own goals then discard them.
Every person is a valuable individual.
People are obstacles to be destroyed if they cross me.
People are untrustworthy. Don't depend on anyone.
Wipe ‘em all out and let the cockroaches take over.

family_background.name: Corporate Execs
family_background.description: Wealthy and powerful, with servants, luxury homes, private security, and a big-name private school.

family_background.name: Corporate Managers
family_background.description: Well-to-do, with a large home, safe neighborhood, nice cars, and a mix of private and corporate education.

family_background.name: Corporate Technicians
family_background.description: Middle-middle class, with a comfortable conapt or Beaverville home and corporate-run technical schooling.

family_background.name: Nomad Pack
family_background.description: Home was a mix of rugged trailers, vehicles, and road kombis; family, fresh food, driving, fighting, and home schooling shaped childhood.

family_background.name: Ganger "Family"
family_background.description: A savage, violent home wherever the gang could take over; hunger, fear, and lessons in fighting, killing, and stealing.

family_background.name: Combat Zoners
family_background.description: A fortified decaying building in the Zone, with intermittent food, a bed when lucky, and home schooling.

family_background.name: Urban Homeless
family_background.description: Cars, dumpsters, or abandoned shipping modules were home; survival meant fighting for scraps and learning from hard knocks.

family_background.name: Megastructure Warren Rats
family_background.description: A tiny conapt in a huge megastructure, kibble and scop, a mostly warm bed, and whatever schooling adults or a Corporation provided.

family_background.name: Reclaimers
family_background.description: Started on the road, then helped rebuild a deserted town or city; a dangerous pioneer life with simple food and home schooling.

family_background.name: Edgerunners
family_background.description: Home changed with the parents' latest job, ranging from luxury to a dumpster and from gourmet food to kibble.

childhood_environment: Ran on The Street, with no adult supervision.
Spent in a safe Corp Zone walled off from the rest of the City.
In a Nomad pack moving from place to place.
In a Nomad pack with roots in transport (ships, planes, caravans).
In a decaying, once upscale neighborhood, now holding off the boosters to survive.
In the heart of the Combat Zone, living in a wrecked building or other squat.
In a huge megastructure controlled by a Corp or the City.
In the ruins of a deserted town or city taken over by Reclaimers.
In a Drift Nation, a floating offshore city and meeting place for all kinds of people.
In a Corporate luxury starscraper, high above the teeming rabble.
